description: Hybro is building the missing interoperability layer for the Agentic future. We enable agents to collaborate and interoperate across boundaries securely and seamlessly.
problem_statement: AI agents are quickly improving in all industries, but they are still trapped in silos. A support agent from company A cannot coordinate with a logistics agent from company B. This lack of cross-boundary interoperability has been overlooked by most people and quietly become the biggest bottleneck to unlocking agentic AI’s true potential.

team.justification: The founding team consists of two members with complementary skills in engineering and business development. However, the small team size and lack of broader functional expertise could be a limitation as the company scales.

company_assessment.business_model_strength: The business model is based on subscriptions and profit sharing with agent builders, which could be scalable but lacks current validation due to pre-revenue status.
company_assessment.market_positioning: Hybro positions itself as a neutral interoperability layer, differentiating from competitors by focusing on openness and neutrality.
company_assessment.execution_capability: The team has demonstrated initial execution capability by launching an alpha product and engaging early users.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: The strategic vision is clear in addressing a significant bottleneck in AI agent interoperability, but execution risks remain due to the nascent stage.
